categories.name: Fruits
categories.description: Fresh mangoes, oranges, pineapples, bananas, plantain, pawpaw, watermelon, avocado and more — the juiciest and freshest Nigerian fruits picked and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Grains and cereals

categories.name: Legumes and Pulses
categories.description: Fresh and high quality beans, soybeans, lentils, cowpea and more — all your favourite Nigerian legumes and pulses available in all sizes and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Nuts And Seeds
categories.description: Premium quality groundnuts, cashew nuts, tiger nuts, egusi, ogbono, sesame seeds and more — fresh, well-processed and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Tubers And Roots
categories.description: Fresh yam, cassava, sweet potatoes, cocoyam, Irish potatoes, garri and more — your favourite Nigerian tubers and roots available in all sizes and delivered fresh to your doorstep.

categories.name: Soup Ingredients
categories.description: Discover everything you need to prepare rich, authentic, and flavorful homemade soups in one place. Our Soup Ingredients collection features carefully selected local essentials including egusi, ogbono, okro, oha leaves, bitter leaves, uziza, stockfish, crayfish, palm oil, spices, dried fish, and more. Whether you’re cooking traditional family favorites or special occasion meals, these fresh and quality ingredients bring out the true taste of African cuisine. From thickening agents to aromatic seasonings and leafy vegetables, enjoy convenience, freshness, and authentic flavor for every delicious pot of soup.

categories.name: Vegetables And Leafy Greens
categories.description: Fresh ugu, bitter leaf, waterleaf, spinach, okra, cabbage, scent leaf and more — the freshest Nigerian vegetables and leafy greens picked and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Pepper & Tomatoes

categories.name: Onions & Bulbs

categories.name: Spices And Herbs
categories.description: Fresh and dried ginger, turmeric, cloves, thyme, ehuru, uziza, alligator pepper, locust beans and more — the richest Nigerian spices and herbs sourced fresh and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Fats And Oils

categories.name: Seasoning And Condiments

categories.name: Meat And Poultry
categories.description: Fresh beef, chicken, turkey, goat meat, pork, offals, ponmo, cow leg and more — premium quality meat and poultry carefully sourced and delivered fresh straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Noodle Pasta & Instant
categories.description: Indomie, spaghetti, macaroni, golden morn, cornflakes, instant oats, poundo yam, semovita, instant fufu and more — all your favourite noodles, pasta and instant foods available and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.description: Zobo, kunu, tigernut drink, fruit juices, malt drinks, energy drinks, Milo, Bournvita, tea, coffee, soft drinks, water and more — all your favourite beverages and drinks delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Kitchen Essentials
categories.description: Cooking salt, baking soda, yeast, baking powder, sugar, honey, vanilla essence, food colouring, foil paper, cling film and more — all your essential kitchen and baking supplies available and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Cookwares & Utensils
categories.description: Upgrade your kitchen setup with our curated collection of high-performance cookware and everyday kitchen tools. Whether you’re simmering a rich stew, frying, or baking, find the reliable pots, pans, and handy utensils designed to make cooking effortless.

categories.name: Dairy And Eggs
categories.description: Fresh eggs, cow milk, evaporated milk, powdered milk, yoghurt, butter, cheese and more — quality dairy products and eggs sourced fresh and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Fish And SeaFood
categories.description: Fresh catfish, tilapia, mackerel, smoked fish, stockfish, crayfish, prawns, periwinkle and more — premium quality fish and seafood carefully sourced and delivered fresh straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Processed Grains & Floor
categories.description: Quality garri, semolina, wheat flour, amala, poundo yam, akamu, corn flour, fufu and more — all your favourite processed grains and flours available in all sizes and delivered fresh to your doorstep.

categories.name: Sauces Pastes & Condiments
categories.description: Tomato paste, pepper sauce, peanut butter, banga sauce, mayonnaise, ketchup, soy sauce, salad cream and more — quality sauces and pastes available and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Snacks & Packaged Food
categories.description: Chin chin, plantain chips, popcorn, kulikuli, biscuits, crackers, kilishi, peanut butter, coconut candy and more — all your favourite Nigerian snacks and packaged foods available and delivered straight to your doorstep.

categories.name: Wines & Spirits
categories.description: Elevating your celebrations, quiet dinners, and festive gatherings becomes completely effortless with our premium selection of global and local wines and spirits. From rich, full-bodied red wines and crisp, refreshing whites to celebratory champagnes, non-alcoholic family favorites, and sophisticated liquors, our curated collection is built for every palate and occasion. Whether you are hosting a major event, gifting a colleague, or simply unwinding after a busy week, we bring top-tier bottles straight to your doorstep. Browse our collection to find the perfect blend to pour, toast, and savor.

categories.name: Household Essentials
categories.description: Discover our collection of durable, practical, and stylish household essentials designed to make daily chores a breeze. From vibrant kitchen accessories and space-saving organizers to heavy-duty cleaning supplies and waste management solutions, we have everything you need to keep your home clean, organized, and running smoothly.
